g.aria-label: "Keystone Flag" designed by Tara Stark for the public domain
Construction/Dimensions for Government Display specs of the
Note that the hoist is on the sinister (right) side of the design. This is intenional. Pictured below is the flag hung vertically.
The flag may be reproduced with any proportion between 1:1.5 and 1:2. The dimensions of the keystone stretch with the field. Proportions pictured here are 3:5 (above) and 2:3 (right).
